title: Vampire: masters of the night
changes: New Night passive, Child of the Night: at night you hit harder, heal from the damage you deal and move faster.
Nightfall now turns the land around you into night for 10s, and Child of the Night counts it as night.
Mist Form leaves a thick, rolling cloud of mist, and Bat Swarm flies out as a real swarm in a tighter cloud.
